The flames instantly shrink and extinguish, leaving a trail of steam. The tiny villagers stop running, look up, and bow in gratitude. Camera remains static. Tilt-shift miniature aesthetic. Forest village background with warm-to-cool lighting shift. 9:16 vertical format. Duration: 13 seconds.
